title: mcp-relayd configuration
description: Configuration schema for the mcp-relayd daemon

$schema.description: URL or path to the mcp-relayd configuration schema

schema.description: Alternative property for the configuration schema URL or path

gateway.description: Public loopback listener settings and shutdown budget

host.description: Loopback IP address or localhost resolving exclusively to loopback

port.description: TCP port number for the HTTP gateway listener

shutdown_timeout.description: Positive Go duration defining the graceful shutdown timeout (e.g. 10s, 1m)

command.description: Command or path for the external bridge proxy executable

startup_timeout.description: Positive Go duration defining the proxy startup timeout (e.g. 30s, 1m)

servers.description: Upstream stdio MCP servers keyed by unique route-safe server name

command.description: Command executable to run for the upstream server

args.description: Command-line arguments for the server command

cwd.description: Working directory for the server process (empty uses daemon working directory)

autostart.description: Whether to start this server automatically on daemon launch

env.description: Environment variables with ${VAR} expansion support from daemon process environment
